name: What Works Clearinghouse practice guides
summary: Recommendations from the U.S. Institute of Education Sciences for challenges in classrooms and schools, on topics such as foundational reading, writing, fractions, algebra and behavior.

license.note: A U.S. government work: "This report is in the public domain." Checked in the 2024 guide; older guides may quote others' material.

made_by: Institute of Education Sciences, U.S. Department of Education
cite: Cite each guide as its front matter asks, for example: Lane, K. L., et al. (2024). Teacher-Delivered Behavioral Interventions in Grades K–5 (WWC 2025001). National Center for Education Evaluation and Regional Assistance.

fits.how: Each guide's recommendations and evidence ratings become a knowledge folder a Knowledge step searches.

connect.note: Each guide's recommendations with their evidence ratings, as files a Knowledge step searches and cites. Not the guides' full text, which is in PDFs a local run doesn't read. It lets an agent say what the guides recommend; whether its replies improve is yours to test.
